notes:
Diastema 0.32.0-beta.2 (beta)

This beta is everything Diastema has, in one build: the stable version (through 0.29.10) and every beta since. An office that switches from stable to beta gets it. With Open Dental, the office works the way it does today.

Changed since 0.32.0-beta.1

- Forms filed before Diastema: a returning patient who never signed forms in Diastema, and whose only health history is a Flex Health History Update or New Patient Form from over 12 months ago, now shows the Update as due. Before, with "Also count patients who never signed forms in Diastema" off, Diastema never looked in that patient's Images, so their old Flex form was never found and nothing showed as due. Diastema now looks in the Images of any patient with no health history on file (when the patient page opens, and for the day's schedule), and the form it finds starts the 12 months. A patient with nothing in their Images still isn't asked. An appointment reminder set to carry forms carries the Update packet for these patients too.

New if you are coming from stable 0.29.10

- Settings → People: staff accounts. Add someone by name, invite them by email or text, and they choose their own PIN. Everyone who signs in today keeps their name and PIN, and signing in works the same.
- Settings → People has a "Chart" heading with one new permission, "Enter chart work the practice management system could not take". It is on for every level.
- To the chart: a new page for anything Diastema couldn't write into Open Dental and someone has to enter by hand, with Done and Undo. It shows in the menu only when something is on it. With Open Dental it stays empty unless a write fails for good.
- Settings → Office → Practice management system: a card that says how Diastema reaches the office's system ("Open Dental API, direct").
- Settings → Office → Records (administrators): how long Diastema keeps its own copies of signed forms, plans and receipts, and a download of everything it keeps.
- Locations: an office with more than one location can see each page for one location or all of them, and set hours, phone and address per location (Settings → Office → Locations). An office with one location sees no change and no Locations page.
- Analytics → Providers: each dentist's and hygienist's numbers side by side. It stays off until a manager turns on "Show the Providers page" in Settings → Analytics.
- Reworded messages: where a message is about something in the patient's record (their email address, mobile phone, birthdate, allergies, medicines, language, or whether they may be texted), it now says "the chart" instead of "Open Dental". A few scheduling messages say "location" where they named Open Dental's clinics. The meaning is the same. Nothing Diastema writes into the patient's chart changed, and saved messages and settings keep their words.
- Settings → Treatment plans → Procedure descriptions has the choice "Diastema's everyday term", and the Layman's terms page has Remove from Open Dental. Both have been on stable since 0.29.2.

Changed since 0.31.0-beta.2

These were released on stable from 0.29.4 to 0.29.10 and are new to the beta channel:

- Settings → Automatic messages: every automatic text and email in one place, with one Pause for all of them.
- Treatment plan printouts keep their margins and shrink to one page. The financing QR code is on paper only (a link on screens). From an iPad or iPhone they print at the same size as from a computer, and Present mode's Print prints the plan printout, not the screen.
- Forms filed before Diastema: with Settings → Patient forms → What's due → Count forms filed before Diastema turned on, a patient whose Flex New Patient Form or Health History Update PDF is already in their Images isn't asked for it again, and a new patient whose New Patient Form is there doesn't get the automatic welcome email or new-patient text.
- Present mode: the staff drawer opens without a PIN (leaving Present mode still asks for one); Diastema reopened after the Present mode tab was closed starts at the sign-in screen; when only financing is shown, a Pay in full card shows beside it.
- Perio maintenance (D4910) on a recall visit no longer makes a treatment plan read as booked (0.29.3).

Not switched on for an Open Dental office

This beta also carries Diastema's connection to NexHealth and the pieces for practices that Diastema hosts on its own servers. Both are built and tested, but not yet proven with a real practice, and neither is switched on for an office that uses Open Dental. Nothing changes for your office unless Diastema support changes how it connects, which this beta does not do.

Before you switch

A database update runs once at the first start. It takes under a second, keeps every sign-in, paired computer and setting, and saves a copy of the database first (in the data folder's backups, named "before-v49"). Keep that copy. Going back to stable afterward means restoring it, and anything Diastema recorded after the upgrade (new tasks, signed forms, texts, payments and the like) is lost from Diastema. What was written into Open Dental stays there.
